# Applications

One card per kind of thing you make. A card sets the three [switches](../switches.md), names the template to start from and says where the signature goes. It records only what the template can't decide on its own.

| Card | Level | Intensity | Theme | Medium | Start from |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Personal website](./website.md) | personal | 02 | light | web | `examples/web/site.html` |
| [Project app](./project-app.md) | project | 02 | per project | web | `examples/web/app.html` |
| [CV](./cv.md) | personal | 01 (or 02) | light | A4 | `fpcv` LaTeX class |
| [Letter](./letter.md) | personal | 01 (or 02) | light | A4 | `fpletter` LaTeX class |
| [Slides](./slides.md) | personal | 04 | light | 16:9 | `faceplate` Beamer theme |
| [PCB](./pcb.md) | project | — | — | physical | `faceplate` KiCad library |

One intensity per artifact: a card names a single level, and it holds for every page, screen or slide. → [switches](../switches.md#intensity)

**No card for what you're making?** Choose the switches yourself. If you make the same kind of thing a second time, add a card here.
